  (argument: typeof value): void;

function local() {
  let variable: string | number = 'local';

  class Field {value: typeof variable = 1;}
  console.log(closure('a'), declared(1), captured('b'), method.invoke('c'), new expression().invoke('d'), new Field().value);
}
